value.text:
Ibaraki Teacher Training Center (茨城県教育研修センター) is a prefectural educational research and staff training institution in Kasama, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan. Established by Ibaraki Prefecture and administered by its Board of Education, the center conducts research on education and provides training for educational personnel. Its responsibilities also include educational consultation, support for training within schools, and the collection and provision of educational information. It is an educational institution governed under the prefectural ordinance concerning educational institutions other than schools.

Its institutional history includes several distinct predecessor organizations. The Ibaraki Prefectural Science Education Center was established in June 1962. In December 1964 that center was abolished and replaced by the Ibaraki Prefectural Education Training Center. A separate prefectural information processing education center was established in April 1977. The present center was established in April 1992, integrating the information processing education center, following the abolition of the former prefectural education training center. The center’s listed work also covers practical information education activities for high school and secondary school students, as well as social physical education and sport. Its organizational sections include planning and administration, teacher education, subject education, information education, educational consultation, and special needs education.
